old_problem: Pending values were the DC-SCM revision, rear-port topology, stress profile and environmental/error limits.
disposition_reason: ED-03 permits signed runtime mapping/profile parameters; ED-09 retains physical module/cable/chamber work; ED-14 preserves 12 hours; ED-15 keeps per-port acceptance explicit; ED-17 preserves baseline evidence.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row37 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3075 and actual next row38/history3076 were read.
The DC-SCM revision and both rear connector paths must be independently identified because shared power/hub resets can affect both.
Per-port integrity and re-enumeration evidence must be synchronized to the dry 0C/+5% trace.
Dry warm-up and nominal restoration are mandatory; no test ran.

test_case.test_name: DC-SCM rear USB2 slots1-2 12-hour stress at 0C/+5% rails
test_case.purpose: Verify both DC-SCM rear USB2 paths sustain the signed 12-hour load at cold/high-rail margin without integrity failure, reconnect, shared-controller reset or platform event.
required_package: DC-SCM revision and both rear port/tool/hub maps
Abort, dry warm-up and restoration plan
test_case.test_command: Qualified staff establish dry 0C/+5% conditions, verify both DC-SCM rear tools, run the approved 12-hour dual-port SST profile with connector-specific continuity/integrity telemetry, then warm dry and restore nominal state.
test_case.expected_result: Both ports complete full coverage without data mismatch or disallowed reconnect/reset/controller/kernel/SEL event and remain healthy after restoration.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the named DC-SCM revision, both rear paths, full duration and signed per-port limits; front-port evidence, one connector or aggregate SST success cannot pass.
safety_gate: Abort on condensation, electrical/thermal fault, controller instability or data mismatch
No auto-retry; warm above dew point before access
test_case.recovery: Stop, preserve correlated evidence, restore nominal rails, warm/dry above dew point, recover the approved DC-SCM topology and do not auto-retry.

source_conflict.reason: Sources align on both DC-SCM rear ports.
